answers.q1: pip with a venv (no uv/poetry). Use the repo's script, which creates ./venv and runs `pip install -U pip` and `pip install -r requirements.txt`. Command: `scripts/install`
answers.q2: `scripts/test`. This runs `scripts/check` (lint, format and mypy) locally, then `coverage run -m pytest`, then `scripts/coverage`, which requires 100% coverage. For pytest alone, use `venv/bin/python -m pytest` (or `python -m pytest` outside the venv).
answers.q3: `venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/client/test_auth.py` (or `python -m pytest tests/client/test_auth.py` if you aren't using the venv). `scripts/test tests/client/test_auth.py` also works, because it forwards its arguments to pytest. However, it runs the full lint check first and then the 100% coverage check, which will fail on a partial run.
answers.q4: `scripts/check`. CI runs this exact script. It runs `./scripts/sync-version`, `ruff format httpx tests --diff`, `mypy httpx tests` and `ruff check httpx tests`, using venv/bin if a venv exists. CI also runs `scripts/build` (python -m build, twine check dist/*, mkdocs build) and `scripts/coverage`. To auto-fix lint and formatting, run `scripts/lint`.
